## Read in unfiltered samples

```{r}
library(SpatialFeatureExperiment)
library(SpatialExperiment)

base_dirs <- "~/Google Drive/My Drive/research/Cachectic_Visium/"
sample_dirs <- c("Sample_S54407_Sham1_3_5",
                 "Sample_S54410_C26Ctrl_7_9_11",
                 "Sample_S54409_C26Sh_16_18_20",
                 "Sample_S54408_C26Sh_17_19_21"
                 )

spe <- read10xVisium(paste0(base_dirs, sample_dirs, "/outs"),
                     sample_id = c("Sham", "C26Ctrl", "C26T16", "C26T17"),
                     type="sparse",
                     images = "lowres",
                     data="raw")

spe
colData(spe)
table(spe$in_tissue, spe$sample_id)
```

First look at the samples

```{r}
library(scater)
library(ggspavis)

spe <- addPerCellQCMetrics(spe)

plotVisium(spe, fill="sum", trans="log10")
```

## Filtering and sample splitting

We can filter the spots, mostly using 10X algorithm, but removing the top-right corner of C26Ctrl.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
theme_set(theme_bw())

plotSpots(spe[, spe$sample_id=="C26Ctrl"])

as.data.frame(colData(spe)) |>
    dplyr::filter(in_tissue & sample_id=="C26Ctrl") |>
    ggplot(aes(-array_row, -array_col)) +
    geom_point()
```

We need to split the samples, I would hope that a simple clustering of the coordinates will do the job.

### C26 control

```{r}
library(dbscan)

C26Ctrl <- spe[, spe$in_tissue & spe$sample_id=="C26Ctrl"]
coords <- spatialCoords(C26Ctrl)

cl <- dbscan(coords, eps = 300, minPts = 10)
table(cl$cluster)

as.data.frame(colData(C26Ctrl)) |>
    ggplot(aes(-array_row, -array_col, color=as.factor(cl$cluster))) +
    geom_point()

C26Ctrl_1 <- C26Ctrl[, cl$cluster==1]
C26Ctrl_2 <- C26Ctrl[, cl$cluster==2]

plotVisium(C26Ctrl_1, fill="sum", trans="log10")
plotVisium(C26Ctrl_2, fill="sum", trans="log10")
```

### Add tissue ID to full object

```{r}
spe$tissue_id <- rep(NA_character_, ncol(spe))

colData(spe)[spe$sample_id=="Sham",][colnames(Sham_1),"tissue_id"] <- "Sham_1"
colData(spe)[spe$sample_id=="Sham",][colnames(Sham_2),"tissue_id"] <- "Sham_2"
colData(spe)[spe$sample_id=="Sham",][colnames(Sham_3),"tissue_id"] <- "Sham_3"

colData(spe)[spe$sample_id=="C26T16",][colnames(C26T16_1),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T16_1"
colData(spe)[spe$sample_id=="C26T16",][colnames(C26T16_2),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T16_2"
colData(spe)[spe$sample_id=="C26T16",][colnames(C26T16_3),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T16_3"

colData(spe)[spe$sample_id=="C26T17",][colnames(C26T17_1),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T17_1"
colData(spe)[spe$sample_id=="C26T17",][colnames(C26T17_2),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T17_2"
colData(spe)[spe$sample_id=="C26T17",][colnames(C26T17_3),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T17_3"

colData(spe)[spe$sample_id=="C26Ctrl",][colnames(C26Ctrl_1),"tissue_id"] <- "C26Ctrl_1"
colData(spe)[spe$sample_id=="C26Ctrl",][colnames(C26Ctrl_2),"tissue_id"] <- "C26Ctrl_2"

spe$tissue_id <- as.factor(spe$tissue_id)

plotVisium(spe, fill="tissue_id") +
    scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set3")

plotSpots(spe, annotate="tissue_id") +
    scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set3")

saveRDS(spe, file="spe_annotated.rds")
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis

Plot total counts and three interesting genes.

```{r}
library(scater)
spe <- logNormCounts(spe)

colData(spe)$Trim63 <- logcounts(spe)[rowData(spe)$symbol == "Trim63",]
colData(spe)$Foxo1 <- logcounts(spe)[rowData(spe)$symbol == "Foxo1",]
colData(spe)$Foxo3 <- logcounts(spe)[rowData(spe)$symbol == "Foxo3",]

plotVisium(spe[,!is.na(spe$tissue_id)], fill="sum", trans="log10")
plotSpots(spe[,!is.na(spe$tissue_id)], annotate="sum")

plotVisium(spe[,!is.na(spe$tissue_id)], fill="Trim63")
plotSpots(spe[,!is.na(spe$tissue_id)], annotate="Trim63")

plotVisium(spe[,!is.na(spe$tissue_id)], fill="Foxo1")
plotSpots(spe[,!is.na(spe$tissue_id)], annotate="Foxo1")

plotVisium(spe[,!is.na(spe$tissue_id)], fill="Foxo3")
plotSpots(spe[,!is.na(spe$tissue_id)], annotate="Foxo3")
```

### PCA of pseudobulk

```{r}
# create pseudobulk
library(scuttle)
pb <- aggregateAcrossCells(spe, ids=spe$tissue_id)
pb <- computeLibraryFactors(pb)
pb <- logNormCounts(pb)
pb <- runPCA(pb, BSPARAM = BiocSingular::ExactParam(), ncomponents=10)
plotPCA(pb, color_by = "tissue_id", point_size=4)
```

```{r}
rownames(pb) <- rowData(pb)$symbol
feats <- rownames(pb)[which(rowData(pb)$symbol %in% c("Trim63", "Foxo1", "Foxo3"))]
plotHeatmap(pb, feats, color_columns_by = "sample_id")
```
